apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Milestones now work per season as well as across a whole career. A new
  season or a winter team says "First goal of Winter 2026–27" instead of
  "First goal for <team>"
- New milestones: first career goal and assist, and every 5 goals in a
  season or tournament
- Scoring streaks count per team, so a winter team's games don't join up
  with the fall club's

The 2.23.0 iPhone build couldn't run, so this is the same release:

- When the half's time is up, the game clock asks whether to end the half.
  Yes goes to halftime (or full time); No keeps the clock running, and you
  can end the half yourself whenever you're ready
- One running clock for leagues with no halves (e.g. winter indoor): in a
  team's Edit, choose "One running clock" and set the game length

- Finishing scoring now turns the game's live link off. Anyone already
  watching keeps seeing the final score; the link stops working after that

- Swipe left on any play in Play by play to delete it, not just the last
  one. The score and the player's totals update to match
- Going back (or swiping back) from a game's recap now goes to the team's
  Events, not back into the scoring screen

- Kickoff countdown: in the hour before a game, opening the app (for example
  from the 1-hour reminder) puts a "Kickoff in 59:48" countdown with both
  logos on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. It keeps counting with
  the app closed, and turns into the live score when you tap Score game
- Fixed: the live score on the lock screen could be blank until the first
  goal or clock change

apps.name: Soccer Stats Beta
apps.subtitle: Test builds of upcoming features
apps.localizedDescription: Test builds of Soccer Stats with features that aren’t released yet. Installs alongside the normal app.

versions.localizedDescription: New Live Activity look (app name, LIVE/FINAL, logos), game clock with minutes per half, opponent logos.
Tap the live score to open the scoring screen. After Done, the final score stays on the lock screen for 30 minutes.
Fix: the live score code wasn't connected. The scoring screen now shows a small 'Live:' status next to Done.
